workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_generalization: normal-retention boundary under residual alpha

workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no replay result, repair, PPO, or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if design admits PPO or promotion
stop if design treats lower alpha as retroactive acceptance of M777

fallback_plan: if a lower alpha preserves strict normal retention and still improves intervention sensitivity, audit as a limited alpha-feasibility result
if every useful alpha collides at source 77025/source_index 12, design explicit normal-margin retention or boundary-source repair
if lower alphas pass normal retention but lose intervention signal, redesign residual objective scale or target selection
if additional normal sources fail, pivot back to source-balanced mining and objective normal-retention design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M778 admits only a pre-registered boundary alpha probe after M777 strict-normal-retention failure

hypothesis: M777's strict normal-retention failure may be a narrow alpha-threshold cliff around one near-boundary source; a pre-registered lower-alpha probe can test whether residual intervention sensitivity survives under strict normal retention.
success_criteria: M779 fixes the probe inputs to M568 actor, M761 residual head, and M773 positive/contrast rows

failure_criteria: design runs replay instead of only designing it
design trains actor or residual parameters

decision_rule: M779 may only design a lower-alpha normal-boundary probe. It must not run replay, train, run PPO, mutate actor or residual parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
